players.product: atomic force microscopes (AFM) for in-line metrology

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 earnings deck (consolidated, KRW 100 million units): Q2 revenue by product industrial AFM KRW 36.2 billion, research KRW 13.6 billion, service KRW 3.2 billion (domestic KRW 2.8 billion, overseas KRW 50.2 billion); H1 revenue split industrial 65%, research 28%, service 7%. The company attributes the 10% YoY decline in H1 revenue to weak industrial-equipment shipments in Q1; H1 gross margin rose to 68%, while SG&A rose 29% YoY on higher R&D, personnel and sales-commission costs, leaving an H1 operating margin of 7%. Q2 order intake KRW 78.4 billion (industrial KRW 50.4 billion, research KRW 23.1 billion, service KRW 4.9 billion) vs KRW 32.3 billion in Q2 2025; H1 orders KRW 141.3 billion (industrial 68%, research 26%, service 6%); order backlog KRW 112.5 billion at end-Q2 (industrial 76% = KRW 85.9 billion, research KRW 22.5 billion, service KRW 4.1 billion) vs KRW 69.3 billion a year earlier.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 orders KRW 78.4 billion (industrial KRW 50.4 billion; Q2 2025: KRW 32.3 billion); backlog KRW 112.5 billion (industrial KRW 85.9 billion); Q2 industrial revenue KRW 36.2 billion

quarterly_data.signal: Deck highlights: third joint development program with imec launched on 04-20-2026 to co-develop and validate nanometrology for next-generation semiconductors using Park's AFM, WLI, ISE and DHM portfolio on imec's next-generation 3D packaging and logic device samples, and Park Systems joined imec's 3D Systems Integration IIAP for mid- to long-term cooperation in advanced packaging. The NX1 research AFM, delivering atomic-resolution imaging at room temperature (previously an ultra-high-vacuum capability) with standard silicon probes and qPlus sensors, was launched on 04-30-2026. Market opportunities listed: CD/LER/LWR for EUV, CMP, wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding, CMOS image sensors, narrow trenches and fin/gate processes.
quarterly_data.figure: imec third JDP from 04-20-2026 (3D packaging and logic); NX1 launched 04-30-2026
